scripts.build: npm run build --workspace ui && npm run build --workspace app
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace ui && npm run dev --workspace app
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace ui && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace ui && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:api && npm run build --workspace app && npm run build-storybook --workspace ui -- --quiet && npm run test:e2e
